extension.summary: Control your LAN smart home from inside Kodi
extension.description: Paragon Home is part of the Paragon TV project. It controls your LAN smart home from inside Kodi instead of a separate app per brand: Govee lights, Broadlink RM infrared blasters and Tuya smart plugs (GHome, Gosund, Smart Life).[CR][CR]Lights are driven over the Govee LAN API (UDP, no internet round-trip, no rate limit) whenever LAN Control is enabled on the device, and fall back to the Govee Cloud API when it is not. Power, brightness, RGB colour and colour temperature are all supported, along with named scenes you can build and re-use.[CR][CR]An optional background service syncs your lights to playback: dim when something starts, come part-way up on pause, and restore when playback stops. Every action is also reachable through RunScript() so it can be bound to a remote button or saved as a favourite.
extension.news: v2.5.0[CR]Multi-outlet plugs get an "All outlets" entry that switches the whole box in one command.[CR][CR]v2.4.0[CR]Drives Tuya protocol 3.4, which negotiates a session key on every connection.[CR][CR]v2.3.0[CR]Tuya smart plugs can now be switched, not just found. Multi-outlet plugs are listed one device per outlet.[CR][CR]v2.2.2[CR]Dialogs say Paragon Home rather than Paragon Govee, and take the name from the add-on itself.[CR][CR]v2.2.1[CR]New Tuya search diagnostic: says whether the ports opened, what arrived, and why nothing was heard.[CR][CR]v2.2.0[CR]Finds Tuya smart plugs (GHome, Gosund, Smart Life). Switching them needs a local key from your Tuya account - discovery works without one.[CR][CR]v2.1.2[CR]Supports the newer Broadlink data framing used by RM4 and later RM Mini 3 units, and corrects itself if the guess is wrong.[CR][CR]v2.1.1[CR]Broadlink errors are now decoded into words. Error 0xffff means the device is locked in the Broadlink app.[CR][CR]v2.1.0[CR]Broadlink RM support: discovery, IR learning and sending, over the LAN with no cloud account.[CR][CR]v2.0.0[CR]Restructured around a driver interface so other LAN devices can be added. Govee is now the first driver; nothing about your lights, scenes or colours changes.[CR][CR]v1.7.1[CR]Cycle steps now send only the colour, and sends are paced across the lights.[CR][CR]v1.7.0[CR]Mix scenes can now cycle: every light moves to the next colour on a timer you choose.[CR][CR]v1.6.0[CR]New mix scenes: pick several colours and they are spread evenly but randomly over the lights, reshuffling each time.[CR][CR]v1.5.0[CR]The colour list is now yours to edit: add, rename, recolour, reorder and delete colours by hex code.[CR][CR]v1.4.0[CR]A light that misses one search now keeps its name instead of being erased. Added Forget this light.[CR][CR]v1.3.1[CR]Identify now flashes 10 times instead of 3, can be cancelled, and puts the light back as it was.[CR][CR]v1.3.0[CR]New Name lights one by one walkthrough: each light comes on bright magenta in turn while you type its name.[CR][CR]v1.2.0[CR]Colour entry now accepts the 8-digit hex codes the Govee app uses, and says how it read them.[CR][CR]v1.1.4[CR]New Check status reporting test: drives one bulb to a known colour and reads it back, to prove whether the model reports its state honestly.[CR][CR]v1.1.3[CR]A coloured bulb is no longer captured as white when a stale colour temperature sits beside it.[CR][CR]v1.1.2[CR]Capture fixes: brightness scale detection, no more long hang when bulbs are slow, and it now reports what it read.[CR][CR]v1.1.1[CR]Capture is now on the main menu, and the menu title shows the running version.[CR][CR]v1.1.0[CR]Capture the lights' current state as a scene - the way to bring a Govee Tap-to-Run into Kodi.[CR]Scenes can now hold a different setting per light.[CR][CR]v1.0.2[CR]LAN search now probes every network interface and falls back to broadcast.[CR]Added a Diagnose LAN search tool that says why a search found nothing.[CR][CR]v1.0.1[CR]Fixed the background service failing to start on Kodi 17.6 with "TypeError: an integer is required".[CR][CR]v1.0.0[CR]First release.[CR]LAN and Cloud transports with automatic per-device selection.[CR]Power, brightness, colour and colour temperature control.[CR]User-editable scenes.[CR]Playback-reactive lighting service.[CR]RunScript() actions for keymaps and favourites.
